mapper.select: SELECT a.id, m.initial_share_price AS init_price, m.current_share_price AS price, m.total_shares, m.market_cap AS mcap_usd, m.volume_24h, m.change_24h_pct AS change_24h, a.title, ar.name AS artist, ar.bio AS artist_bio, a.image_url, a.image_large_url AS image_large, a.description, a.year, a.medium, a.edition FROM artwork_markets m JOIN artworks a ON m.artwork_id = a.id JOIN artists ar ON a.artist_id = ar.id WHERE a.is_active = 1 AND m.is_tradable = 1 ORDER BY a.id ASC

SELECT a.id, m.initial_share_price AS init_price, m.current_share_price AS price, m.total_shares, m.market_cap AS mcap_usd, m.volume_24h, m.change_24h_pct AS change_24h, a.title, ar.name AS artist, ar.bio AS artist_bio, a.image_url, a.image_large_url AS image_large, a.description, a.year, a.medium, a.edition FROM artwork_markets m JOIN artworks a ON m.artwork_id = a.id JOIN artists ar ON a.artist_id = ar.id WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.is_active = 1 AND m.is_tradable = 1
SELECT t.name FROM artwork_tags at JOIN tags t ON at.tag_id = t.id WHERE at.artwork_id = #{artworkId} ORDER BY t.name ASC

SELECT price, remaining_size AS size, CASE WHEN is_vmm = 1 THEN 'VMM' ELSE CONCAT('User_', COALESCE(user_id, 0)) END AS user, is_vmm FROM order_book_orders WHERE artwork_id = #{artworkId} AND side = #{side} AND status IN ('open', 'partially_filled') ORDER BY
price DESC price ASC
LIMIT 12

SELECT id, artwork_id, price, size, side, CASE WHEN buyer_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('User_', buyer_user_id) WHEN seller_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('User_', seller_user_id) ELSE 'VMM' END AS user, executed_at AS time FROM trade_executions WHERE artwork_id = #{artworkId} ORDER BY executed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 60
SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(recorded_at) * 1000 AS t, price AS p FROM artwork_price_history WHERE artwork_id = #{artworkId} ORDER BY recorded_at ASC LIMIT 200
SELECT artwork_id, quantity FROM portfolio_share_holdings WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND quantity > 0
SELECT id, artwork_id, side, notional, leverage, entry_price, margin_btc, opened_at AS open_time FROM perp_positions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'open' ORDER BY opened_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, artwork_id, type, perp_position_id AS pos_id, tp_price, sl_price, quantity AS qty, status, created_at FROM tpsl_orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'active' ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT current_share_price FROM artwork_markets WHERE artwork_id = #{artworkId} AND is_tradable = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO portfolio_share_holdings (user_id, artwork_id, quantity, avg_cost) VALUES (#{userId}, #{artworkId}, #{quantityDelta}, #{price}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE avg_cost = CASE WHEN quantity + #{quantityDelta} > 0 AND #{quantityDelta} > 0 THEN ((avg_cost * quantity) + (#{price} * #{quantityDelta})) / (quantity + #{quantityDelta}) ELSE avg_cost END, quantity = GREATEST(0, quantity + #{quantityDelta})
mapper.select: SELECT id, artwork_id, side, notional, leverage, entry_price, margin_btc, opened_at AS open_time FROM perp_positions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{posId} AND status = 'open'
